'''January 2001 Geelong tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Geelong, Australia on 20 January 2001. [[Luca Costanzo]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1660">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-22-geelong-australia-20-01-2001d1660/ geelong-australia-20-01-2001], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 22 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-22-geelong-australia-20-01-2001d1660/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Geelong, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Luca Costanzo]]
